items.title: FastWave shares interim results for Sola L-IVL system
items.summary: FastWave Medical has announced interim results from the first-in-human (FIH) feasibility study of its Sola laser intravascular lithotripsy (L-IVL) system for treating calcified coronary artery disease. Thirty patients were treated at two clinical sites.

items.title: AI, ablation innovation and multidisciplinary education to take centre stage at 2026 Heart Rhythm Congress
items.summary: The 2026 Heart Rhythm Congress (HRC; 11–13 October, Birmingham, UK) is set to bring the international heart rhythm community—clinicians, researchers, allied health professionals, patients and industry—together once again, focusing on artificial intelligence (AI), the future of cardiac ablation, and more.

items.title: Innovative tricuspid TEER system wins TCT Plus Middle East Shark Tank competition
items.summary: Startric, the developer of a next-generation transcatheter edge-to-edge repair (TEER) system for the treatment of tricuspid heart valve disease, has been named as the winner of the Shark Tank cardiovascular innovation competition at the 2026 TCT Plus Middle East conference (17–19 September, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia).

items.title: AI software for detecting undiagnosed MR gains US FDA approval
items.summary: Tempus AI has received 510(k) clearance from the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for Tempus ECG-MR, an AI product that analyses standard 12-lead resting electrocardiograms (ECGs) to detect signs associated with undiagnosed moderate or severe mitral regurgitation (MR).

items.title: Delays in receiving TAVI linked to higher risk of heart failure hospitalisation or mortality
items.summary: Prolonged delays in receiving transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) after a diagnosis of severe aortic stenosis (AS) may be associated with a higher risk of hospitalisation for heart failure or all-cause mortality, a real-world, single-centre study from Japan has found.

items.title: StopAfib.org announces recipient of 2026 Eric N Prystowsky Advocate for Patients Award
items.summary: At its recent annual patient conference (7–9 August, Dallas, USA), StopAfib.org bestowed its prestigious Eric N Prystowsky Advocate for Patients Award on Jonathan Piccini (Duke University, Durham, USA) to recognise his “outstanding commitment” to atrial fibrillation (AF) patients and their families.
